title: Classical finite reduction models compatible with proper direct image
statement: Use the standing finite-type setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of Q_l, with its continuous condensed integer ring O_E. Let k be a field of positive prime characteristic different from l, let X and Y be separated finite-type k-schemes, and let p:X→Y be proper. Use ordinary internal module-object derived pushforward [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] and finite constant-model bounded constructibility [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. For a bounded constructible integral complex K, and n≥0, set R=O_E/(pi^{n+1}) and let W_Z be exact forgetting of R-module etale sheaves followed by etale-to-proetale inverse image. There exists an etale R-module complex L such that its realization W_X L is isomorphic to the underlying abelian complex of integralLevel_n K, and W_Y Rp_*L is isomorphic to the underlying abelian complex of integralLevel_n Rp_*K [sk-def-pe-derived-completion]. No dimension bound or cohomological direct-image estimate is asserted; both comparisons retain the ordinary images.

proof.text: The two-term free resolution of the positive quotient identifies derived reduction with the uniformizer-power cone. Finite constant stratified presentations survive this reduction; use the first-reduction criterion and its successive-quotient triangles for constructibility at every positive level.

Identify the continuous finite quotient with the finite discrete constant coefficient ring. The finite coefficient realization is an exact equivalence retaining underlying abelian sheaves. The finite constructible origin theorem and bounded classical derived equivalence supply the etale complex L and the first realization isomorphism. Transport a universe-zero finite coefficient model back along the finite ring equivalence.

The quotient is perfect by its two-term resolution, so the perfect coefficient projection formula identifies reduction of ordinary Rp_*K with ordinary image of the reduction. The discrete qcqs direct-image comparison identifies the latter with etale Rp_*L. Exact restriction and forgetting scalars give the displayed abelian isomorphism.

theorem integralProperReductionModel
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ l)]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p]
    (K : DerivedCategory (AdicCompletion.Modules l E X))
    (hK : constantModelBoundedConstructible (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) X K)
    (n : ℕ) :
    let R := ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))
    let W (Z : Scheme.{u}) := sheafCompose Z.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) Ab.{u + 1}) ⋙ comparisonUpperStar Ab.{u + 1} Z
    ∃ L : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)),
      Nonempty ((Mod.forget (AdicCompletion.ring l E X)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (AdicCompletion.integralLevel l E X K n) ≅ (W X).mapDerivedCategory.obj L) ∧
      Nonempty ((Mod.forget (AdicCompletion.ring l E Y)).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (AdicCompletion.integralLevel l E Y
          ((CondensedRing.moduleObjectDerivedPushforward
            (DerivedNakayama.integerRing l E) p).obj K) n) ≅
        (W Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj
          ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj L))
